OK so `ndpi_snprintf` uses `vsnprintf` which properly NUL-terminates. So `rdnSeqBuf` should be properly NUL-terminated after `ndpi_snprintf` writes to it.

Let me think about this differently. The crash is "Use-of-uninitialized-value in ndpi_strdup". The `ndpi_strdup` calls `strlen(s)` on the input. If `s` points to a buffer that contains uninitialized bytes (no NUL terminator within the initialized region), `strlen` will read uninitialized memory.
